This efficiency is further supported by the scanX signal engine, which identifies that earnings growth is currently accelerating [E51]. While the market currently prices the stock at a negative book value, this valuation anomaly at -0.78x price-to-book suggests the market has yet to price in the company's operational recovery [E1]. Recent performance shows a positive shift, with compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months reaching 11%, aligning closely with the sector median of 11.9% [E14, E59]. Despite these historical headwinds, the combination of high capital efficiency and accelerating earnings signals a business that is fundamentally evolving [E8, E51].

These structural operational declines are further compounded by a weak return on assets of -6.83%, which lags far behind the sector benchmark of 2.31% [E7]. Market expectations have also become detached from underlying reality, with price growth exceeding profit growth by 151% [E44] while offering a completely absent dividend yield of 0.00% [E3].
